title: Create a PcbLib with a footprint and extruded body
summary: Creates and saves a new PCB library from code, registers a new footprint and gives it an extruded 3D component body built from a square outline. Shows the order of outline and extruded model, and how library coordinates read back.
phrasings: create a new PCB library programmatically
add a footprint to a PcbLib
add an extruded 3D body to a footprint
make a component body with a height

commands.name: CreatePcbLib
commands.description: Create a PcbLib with a footprint and an extruded 3D body
commands.params: Out=<folder> (default temp)|Name=<file name> (default test.PcbLib)|Pattern=<footprint name> (default TestComp)|Overwrite=true (optional)
